'''Stroh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with Imperial forces under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Marr]]. There Burr engaged in a conversation with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Burr (individual)|Burr]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a man who under normal circumstances would be his enemy.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Stroh appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
